0.3.12.changelog:
Loads the actual TradeBook JSON exports (metadata.ast shape) and drives
RunningStrategy with synthetic tick sequences — same pattern as the
existing sfv-dual-berettas.test.ts. Two fixtures, 22 tests:

Sharkfin 4-leg Nifty (13 tests):
  - AST shape pinning: 4 legs, per-leg SL -20%, per-leg TSL:11/1/2/1
    wrapped in AND(sibling LEG_EXIT with SL, tsl), roll-up gate
    (LEG_QTY==0 + time >= 11:00), re-entry cooldown
  - Full cascade sim: CE hits -20% SL -> CE closes -> PE profits past
    +11% activateAt -> HWM ratchets -> PE reverses -> TSL exit fires

Sensex Iron Condor 8-leg (9 tests):
  - AST shape pinning: 4 shorts at offset +9, 4 hedges with
    relative_to_leg for BOTH strike AND expiry (pins the 2026-08-20
    incident regression: expiry.offset MUST be undefined)
  - Correct hedge-to-anchor cross-references
  - Two leg-groups with 09:20-09:25 overnight-close window
  - Deploy smoke test: 8 legs settle to WAITING_ENTRY cleanly

Full strategy-engine suite: 957/957 pass.

Follow-ups tracked: #211 (Sharkfin roll-up + re-entry), #212 (Sensex
hedge resolution + short SL scenario).
